data.title: Payment reminder (Zahlungserinnerung) for unpaid garden invoice
data.summary: Gartencenter Beispielblüte sent a payment reminder because the invoice for planting 6 fruit trees in October (plus a €3.00 reminder fee) — totaling €537.00 — has not yet been paid. They ask for payment by 4 December 2026.
data.explanation: This is a friendly first reminder (Zahlungserinnerung) from the garden center about an unpaid bill of €537.00 for tree planting work done in October. If you already paid, you can ignore this letter as it says. Otherwise, transfer the amount to the IBAN shown using your customer number as reference, by 4 December 2026, to avoid a formal dunning process or additional fees. If you dispute the charge, contact the garden center directly before the deadline.
